title: DPM Health Metrics Protocol Specification
description: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for health metrics across ALL domains - Air-Side, Ground-Side, SystemTools

overview.purpose: Standardize health metric field names, units, types, and structure across entire DPM ecosystem

domains.ground_side: Consumer - receives and displays health data
domains.systemtools: Consumer - receives, stores, and analyzes health data

overview.breaking_change: v2.0.0 introduces mandatory field name standardization - ALL domains MUST migrate

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when snapshot was captured
timestamp.implementation: std::chrono C++, Instant.now() Kotlin, datetime.utcnow().isoformat() Python

system.description: System-level health metrics (CPU, memory, disk, network traffic)

network.description: Network health metrics (TCP, UDP, queue depth)

sync.description: Synchronization health metrics (exposure rate, health rate)

system_metrics.description: System-level health metrics - CPU, memory, disk, network traffic

disk_used_mb.description: Disk space used in megabytes (IMPORTANT: MB not GB)

disk_total_mb.description: Total disk space in megabytes (IMPORTANT: MB not GB)

network_rx_mbps.description: Network receive throughput in megabits per second

network_tx_mbps.description: Network transmit throughput in megabits per second

uptime_seconds.description: System uptime in seconds since boot (optional)

camera_metrics.description: Camera health metrics - connection, latency, USB traffic, errors

sdk_latency_ms.description: Sony SDK operation latency in milliseconds

usb_traffic_mbps.description: USB traffic throughput in megabits per second

error_count.description: Cumulative camera SDK error count since start

network_metrics.description: Network health metrics - TCP connection, latency, UDP loss, queue depth

tcp_connected.description: TCP connection status to Ground-Side (true=connected, false=disconnected)

command_queue_depth.description: Number of pending commands in command queue

sync_metrics.description: Synchronization health metrics - exposure sync, health broadcast, property reads

exposure_rate_hz.description: Camera exposure synchronization rate in Hz

health_rate_hz.description: Health broadcast rate in Hz (should match config)

breaking_changes.old_format: Ground-Side expected disk_free_gb and disk_total_gb in gigabytes
breaking_changes.new_format: ALL domains now use disk_used_mb and disk_total_mb in megabytes
breaking_changes.rationale: Consistency with Air-Side implementation and SystemTools database schema

migration.ground_side: Change HealthSnapshot.kt: disk_free_gb → Remove, disk_total_gb → Remove, Add disk_used_mb and disk_total_mb
migration.systemtools: Remove normalization code in tab_analytics.py lines 344-370
migration.air_side: No changes needed - already using correct format

breaking_changes.migration: Add to Air-Side SystemMetrics::toJson() as optional field

example_snapshot.description: Complete example health snapshot matching v2.0 specification

validation_rules.unit_consistency: CRITICAL: disk values MUST be in MB, not GB

air_side: ✅ SystemMetrics already uses correct field names (disk_used_mb, disk_total_mb)
⚠️ Add uptime_seconds to SystemMetrics::toJson() as optional field
✅ No other changes needed - Air-Side is already compliant!
ground_side: ❌ Update UI calculations to use disk_used_mb instead of calculating from free
❌ Test: Verify health broadcasts parse correctly with new fields
systemtools: ❌ Remove normalization hacks in tab_analytics.py _normalize_snapshot() method
❌ Assume all incoming data matches protocol (no conversion needed)
❌ Update database schema documentation to reference protocol/health_metrics.json
❌ Add protocol validation on health snapshot receipt
❌ Test: Verify analytics dashboard displays correctly with standardized data

unit_tests.ground_side: Test HealthSnapshot.kt parses protocol-compliant JSON correctly
unit_tests.systemtools: Test database stores all protocol fields without transformation

integration_tests.air_to_ground: Air-Side broadcast → Ground-Side receives and displays correctly
integration_tests.air_to_systemtools: Air-Side broadcast → SystemTools stores and visualizes correctly
integration_tests.end_to_end: Verify all domains show same values for same health snapshot

2.0.0.description: BREAKING CHANGE: Standardized disk metrics to use MB across all domains (was GB in Ground-Side)
